select fp.profit_type as prodtype,chbprd.raisemode as raisemode,chbprd.ivstorientation as ivstorientation,chbprd.operate_mode as operateMode, chbprd.cash_mana_cate as cashmanacate,chbprd.openduration as openduration,chbprd.termtype as termtype, nvl(chbprd.endamtsum_Oth,0) as endamtsumOth, nvl(case when fp.profit_type='02' then llcalc.yield when fp.profit_type ='01' then case when jzcalc.strvalue = null or jzcalc.strvalue=0 then 0 else (jzcalc.endvalue-jzcalc.strvalue)/(jzcalc.strvalue*(#{enddate,jdbcType=DATE}-#{startdate,jdbcType=DATE}+1))*decode(finrate.basis,'A/365',365,360) end when fp.profit_type ='03' then case when hbcalc.strvalue = null or hbcalc.strvalue=0 then 0 else (hbcalc.endvalue-hbcalc.strvalue)/(hbcalc.strvalue*(#{enddate,jdbcType=DATE}-#{startdate,jdbcType=DATE}+1))*decode(finrate.basis,'A/365',365,360) end end,0) as prodprice,fp.finprod_id as finprodId from chb_month_prd_position chbprd left join fin_product fp on 'F16_'||chbprd.prodid=fp.finprod_id left join fin_cash_info cash on fp.finprod_Id=cash.finprod_id and cash.cash_type_1='02' left join ( select calc1.cash_id,calc1.finprod_id, calc1.yield,row_number() over(partition by calc1.cash_id,calc1.finprod_id order by calc1.eff_date desc) as idx from FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE calc1 left join fin_product fp on calc1.finprod_id=fp.finprod_id where calc1.eff_date <= #{enddate,jdbcType=DATE} and fp.operation_Type='02' union all select calc1.cash_id,calc1.finprod_id, calc1.yield,row_number() over(partition by calc1.cash_id,calc1.finprod_id order by calc1.eff_date desc) as idx from FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE calc1 left join fin_product fp on calc1.finprod_id=fp.finprod_id where calc1.eff_date = fp.vdate and fp.operation_Type='01' ) llcalc on cash.cash_id=llcalc.cash_id and cash.finprod_id=llcalc.finprod_id and llcalc.idx=1 left join (select endval.finprod_id, nvl(endval.TOTAL_NET_VALUE,0) endvalue, nvl(strval.TOTAL_NET_VALUE,1) strvalue from BOK_VALBAL_TABLE_STATUS endval left join BOK_VALBAL_TABLE_STATUS strval on endval.finprod_id=strval.finprod_id and strval.val_date= #{startdate,jdbcType=DATE}-1 where endval.val_date=#{enddate,jdbcType=DATE})jzcalc on fp.finprod_id=jzcalc.finprod_id left join ( select endval.bookset_id as finprod_id, nvl(endval.subject_name,0) endvalue, nvl(strval.subject_name,vdateval.subject_name) strvalue from bok_val_table_data endval left join bok_val_table_data strval on endval.bookset_id=strval.bookset_id and strval.val_date= #{startdate,jdbcType=DATE}-1 and trim(endval.subject_no)='从成立以来累计万份收益:' and trim(strval.subject_no)='从成立以来累计万份收益:' left join fin_product fp on endval.bookset_id=fp.finprod_id and trim(endval.subject_no)='从成立以来累计万份收益:' left join bok_val_table_data vdateval on fp.finprod_id=vdateval.bookset_id and fp.vdate=vdateval.val_date and trim(vdateval.subject_no)='从成立以来累计万份收益:' where endval.val_date=#{enddate,jdbcType=DATE} and trim(endval.subject_no)='从成立以来累计万份收益:' )hbcalc on fp.finprod_id=hbcalc.finprod_id left join fin_rate_info finrate on finrate.cash_id=cash.cash_id and cash.finprod_id=finrate.finprod_id
inner join data_auth_notify_inst dani on dani.BUSINESS_ID = fp.finprod_id and dani.data_type='FINPROD04' and dani.model_type='02' and dani.institution_code
#{item}
where chbprd.startdate = #{startdate,jdbcType=DATE} and chbprd.enddate = #{enddate,jdbcType=DATE} and chbprd.profit_type='03'

select fp.profit_type as prodtype, chbasset.rating as rating, chbasset.assettype2 as assettype2, decode(chbasset.assettype2,'2617',chbinfo.is_govern_fund,chbasset.is_govern_fund1) isgovernfund1, chbinfo.bank_sec_capital bankseccapital, chbinfo.bank_sec_perpetual banksecperpetual,chbinfo.bank_sec_prefer banksecprefer, repbond.rep_sec_nature as repsecnature, case when chbasset.assettype2 in ('1201','1202','1203','1204','1205','1206','1207','1208','1209','1210','1299') then nvl(chbasset.assetvalue_a,0) else coalesce(chbasset.assetvalue_b,chbasset.assetvalue_a,0) end as assetvalueB, case when chbasset.assettype2 in ('1001','1106','2401','1303','2403','2402','2499','1401','1402','1403','1404','1405','1406','1499') then 1 else nvl((nvl(exeplan.mdate,nvl(asset.mdate,deal.mdate)) - #{enddate,jdbcType=DATE}),0) end as remainterm,fp.finprod_id as finprodId from chb_month_asset_position chbasset left join fin_product fp on 'F16_'||chbasset.prod_id=fp.finprod_id left join fin_product_add d on fp.finprod_id=d.finprod_id left join chb_asset_info chbinfo on chbasset.asset_code=chbinfo.asset_code left join rep_asset_bond repbond on chbinfo.asset_code=repbond.sec_id left join fin_product asset on (chbasset.asset_code=asset.finprod_market_id or chbasset.asset_code=asset.finprod_id) left join trd_product_deal deal on chbasset.asset_code=deal.trade_id left join (select distinct p.finprod_id as prodid,min(p.exercise_date) as mdate from fin_exercise_plan p where p.finprod_type='F01' and p.exercise_date>#{enddate,jdbcType=DATE} group by p.finprod_id ) exeplan on asset.finprod_id=exeplan.prodid and asset.is_sus='Y'
inner join data_auth_notify_inst dani on dani.BUSINESS_ID = fp.finprod_id and dani.data_type='FINPROD04' and dani.model_type='02' and dani.institution_code
#{item}
where chbasset.startdate = #{startdate,jdbcType=DATE} and chbasset.enddate = #{enddate,jdbcType=DATE} and d.profit_flag='03' and chbasset.assettype2 not in ('1701','1702','1703','1704','1705','1706')

select tt.prodtype,tt.assettype2, sum(case when tt.totalnum = null or tt.totalnum=0 then 0 else tt.accuqty/tt.totalnum*tt.posnum end) as assetvalueB,tt.remainterm from ( select distinct fp.profit_type as prodtype,t2.asset_type2 as assettype2, nvl(T1.TOTAL_NUM,0) as totalnum,nvl(T4.ACCUQTY,0) as accuqty,nvl(T1.POS_AMT,0) as posnum,t1.pos_id, nvl((nvl(exeplan.mdate,nvl(asset.mdate,deal.mdate)) - #{enddate,jdbcType=DATE}),0) as remainterm from chb_bot_ast_pos t1 inner join chb_asset_info t2 on t1.plan_asset_id=t2.asset_code inner join chb_asset_info t3 on t1.asset_code=t3.asset_code inner join chb_asset_position t4 on t1.plan_asset_id=t4.asset_code left join fin_product fp on 'F16_'||t4.prod_id=fp.finprod_id left join fin_product_add d on fp.finprod_id=d.finprod_id left join rep_asset_bond repbond on t1.asset_code=repbond.sec_id left join fin_product asset on (t1.asset_code=asset.finprod_market_id or t1.asset_code=asset.finprod_id) left join trd_product_deal deal on t1.asset_code=deal.trade_id left join (select distinct p.finprod_id as prodid,min(p.exercise_date) as mdate from fin_exercise_plan p where p.finprod_type='F01' and p.exercise_date>#{enddate,jdbcType=DATE} group by p.finprod_id ) exeplan on asset.finprod_id=exeplan.prodid and asset.is_sus='Y'
inner join data_auth_notify_inst dani on dani.BUSINESS_ID = fp.finprod_id and dani.data_type='FINPROD04' and dani.model_type='02' and dani.institution_code
#{item}
where t2.asset_type2 in ('1701','1702','1703','1704','1705','1706') and t3.asset_type2 in ('1201','1202','1203','1204','1205','1206','1207','1208','1209','1210','1299') and d.profit_flag='03' and t4.cdate = #{enddate,jdbcType=DATE} and t1.pos_date = #{enddate,jdbcType=DATE} )tt group by tt.prodtype,tt.assettype2,tt.remainterm

SELECT s.institution_code id,s.institution_name text from sys_institution s
and s.institution_code
#{item}
AND (s.institution_code like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) OR s.institution_name like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')))
order by s.institution_code,s.institution_name
